status_disclaimer: RESEARCH / PFA PROTOTYPE. Validated on a held-out subset of a PDFMalware2022 (CIC-Evasive-PDFMal2022 family) dataset, PLUS manual runtime validation against 3 real legitimate PDFs of varying size (one of which was misclassified and is documented, not hidden). NOT production-ready: no external validation set, no adversarial robustness testing, ~92.3% held-out precision means real false positives should be expected.
wording_note: Refer to this model as: 'research/PFA prototype validated on a held-out subset of CIC-Evasive-PDFMal2022 (PDFMalware2022.parquet), plus manual runtime validation against real legitimate PDFs'. Never as 'production-ready'.

dataset.row_quality_rule: Strategy A (complete-case, 8,914 rows) MINUS 975 rows (40 groups) excluded for label-conflicting 16-feature vectors (see validation/PDF-RUNTIME-FIDELITY.md section 3.1) -- final usable population 7,939 rows.
dataset.cic_paper_citation: Issakhani, Victor, Tekeoglu, Lashkari -- 'PDF Malware Detection based on Stacking Learning', ICISSP 2022 (DOI 10.5220/0010908400003120)
dataset.kaggle_relationship: Not sourced from Kaggle in this project -- supplied locally by the user as PDFMalware2022.parquet, matching the CIC-Evasive-PDFMal2022 column family.

feature_schema.model_variant: C (16 features -- pdf_size, nb_obj_kw, nb_page_approx all excluded; all 16 remaining features proven token-identical to PDFiD's published methodology, no runtime-approximation caveats)
feature_schema.pdf_size_decision: REMOVED in schema v4. Training column 'PdfSize' has no documented unit; a third-party reproduction (Mathys-Rituper/PDF-feature-extractor) independently implements round(bytes/1024,2), corroborating a kilobytes hypothesis, but is not the official CIC source (self-described as an 'improved', i.e. reinterpreted, extractor) -- insufficient to meet the 'documented, proven' bar. See validation/PDF-RUNTIME-FIDELITY.md section 1.

removed_features.header_present: Removed in schema v2 -- unreliable runtime reproduction + largest class-conditional data-quality gap (20.03pp).
removed_features.is_encrypted: Removed in schema v3 -- real training column ranges 0-4, undocumented semantics for 2/3/4.
removed_features.pdf_size: Removed in schema v4 -- training-data unit unproven (probable KB vs. runtime bytes); confirmed real-world defect (see pdf_size_decision above and validation/PDF-RUNTIME-FIDELITY.md).
removed_features.nb_obj_kw: Excluded from Model C (also excluded from Model B) -- runtime-approximate.
removed_features.nb_page_approx: Excluded from Model C (also excluded from Model B) -- runtime-approximate.

cleaning_strategy.sentinel_handling: -1 treated as missing, never a real 0-occurrence count.
cleaning_strategy.compound_notation: PDFiD-style 'N(M)' -> N retained, M discarded from the feature vector.
cleaning_strategy.leaked_text_handling: Non-numeric garbage strings treated as missing, never coerced to 0.
cleaning_strategy.complete_case_rule: Strategy A: 8,914 of 10,023 rows (all 19 v3-candidate features observed).

conflicting_label_groups_excluded.resolution: All rows in any conflicting group excluded -- never a majority-vote label choice.

cleaning_strategy.duplicate_group_split_policy: Rows sharing an identical cleaned 16-feature vector (SHA-256 content key, recomputed for Model C's feature set) assigned to a single split -- 0 groups span train/val/test.

model.hyperparameter_search: Modest 3-point search over max_depth in {None, 10, 20}, selected by validation ROC-AUC only.
model.threshold_selection_rationale: Maximizes F2 (recall-weighted, beta=2) on VALIDATION only, tie-broken by higher recall.

validation_rationale: Model C selected over Model B (17 features, included pdf_size) because Model B's pdf_size relies on an unverified training-data unit that the runtime extractor could not reproduce (confirmed defect: real PDFs' raw byte counts are 100-1000x beyond the training range). Model C's recall/FN-rate are comparable or marginally better than Model B despite a measurable precision/FPR cost, and all 16 remaining features are proven runtime-identical -- per instruction, runtime semantic correctness outweighs the marginal metric loss. See validation/PDF-RUNTIME-FIDELITY.md section 4.
runtime_fidelity_validation: Real, legitimate, size-diverse local PDFs (4.2 KB, 103 KB, 1.45 MB) run through the exact production path. Medium and large correctly classified sain (proba 0.06, 0.002). Small fixture misclassified malveillant (proba 0.73) -- investigated (not patched): driven by a genuine, sparsely-populated joint feature region (OpenAction + double-xref), not an out-of-distribution value. See validation/PDF-RUNTIME-FIDELITY.md section 5 for full detail.
known_limitations: Real-world false positive OBSERVED and documented (not hidden): a small (4.2 KB) legitimate PDF was classified malveillant (proba 0.73) during manual runtime testing -- driven by a sparsely-populated joint feature region (OpenAction + double-xref present together), not an out-of-distribution value. Held-out precision (~92.3%) predicts this kind of error will occur on real files. See validation/PDF-RUNTIME-FIDELITY.md section 5.

975 rows (11% of the complete-case dataset) were excluded because their 16-feature vectors collide with an opposite-label row -- Model C has seen even less of the original population's diversity than Model B did.
No external validation set was used -- all metrics come from splits of a single dataset file.
No adversarial robustness testing was performed.

pdf_size's true unit remains genuinely unresolved (probable KB, not proven) -- removed from the model rather than guessed; a future phase could re-investigate with authoritative documentation or a controlled re-derivation.
Complete-case filtering (both the original 19-feature pass and this phase's additional 16-feature conflict exclusion) removed disproportionately more of the original Malicious class than Benign.
no_external_validation_disclaimer: No dataset other than local splits of PDFMalware2022.parquet was used for training/held-out evaluation. Runtime validation used 3 real local PDFs (not a formal external validation set).
